## Code Review Summary

**Subject:** specification mode — `ticket02-spec-r3.md`, revision r3, repair round for F1–F6.
**Files reviewed:** 1 candidate + 14 source/test anchors (all re-read).
**Issues:** 7 — CRITICAL 0 · HIGH 1 · MEDIUM 4 · LOW 2.
**Limit:** no hashing/shell tool is granted, so the supplied sha256 could not be recomputed; content was reviewed at the bound path.

### Issues

**N1 [HIGH][statement-contradiction]** Fast path bypasses the encoded-length invariant.
Anchor: spec:80 vs R1 spec:20, AC2(b) spec:105. A description of 24 `"` has no W-class char and 24 bytes ≤36, so the fast path returns it unmarked at 48 encoded bytes — AC2(b) fails. Four 36-quote hits take the envelope to ≈2221 B > 2048. Fix: delete the fast path, or gate it on bytes free of `"` `\` `<` `>` `&`, controls and ≥0x80; otherwise measure encoded length. Confidence HIGH.

**N2 [MEDIUM][statement-contradiction]** Degenerate-config claims are false.
Anchor: spec:22/R2, spec:54, spec:78, spec:91, spec:153/§8 ("fail every search", "behave exactly as before"). T1's clamp (spec:121) in `withDefaults` (search.go:88-110), used by `NewSearcher` (:328-331) and `DecodeRequest` (:143-146), turns default 10/max 5 into 3/4, which now validates — searches succeed where all previously failed. Fix: state the real subset rule (`min(d,3) ≤ min(m,4)` admits; `m<3` or `min(d,3)>min(m,4)` still fails at validate), drop "unchanged", note #165's premise is partly superseded. Confidence HIGH.

**N3 [MEDIUM][r-ac-coverage-gap]** F3 inventory is not exact; residual citations are wrong.
Anchor: spec:64, spec:126-130. Unlisted per-hit readers in the claimed file: `serve_test.go:265-289` (`catalogRevisionAndTool` reads `row["server"]`; used :629,:688) and `:685` (`row["server"]!="beta"`). The residual instruction "serve_test.go :653/:971 rows (drop per-hit availability)" points at call_tool envelope must-not-contain loops — acting on it deletes AC6 coverage. Fix: name :265-289 and :685 as tool_name-only rewrites; correct the :653/:971 cites. Confidence HIGH.

**N4 [MEDIUM][statement-contradiction]** Advertised vs enforced bounds can diverge.
Anchor: spec:78 ("cannot diverge"), T2 spec:123. Five tests build `&ToolSurface{...}` bypassing `NewToolSurface`: builtin_guidance_test.go:164, tool_metadata_test.go:89, service_edge_test.go:559, tools_publish_atomic_test.go:17, bounded_delivery_test.go:377. Stored-bounds design renders `SearchToolsInputSchema(0,0)` (default 0/maximum 0 vs `minimum:1`) while admission enforces 3/4. Fix: bounds accessor falls back to `cfg.Search.EffectiveBounds()` when zero; add these sites to T2. Confidence HIGH.

**N5 [MEDIUM][statement-contradiction]** §4 arithmetic undercounts.
Anchor: spec:85-87, AD2 spec:53. Recomputed with the stated components: root 204 (not 202), payload 871, total 61+871+(871+58+144) = 2005 → margin 43, not 2001/47. General form 1573+12B ⇒ B ≤ 39; "≤42" and "≥43 violate" are wrong. 36 remains safe. Fix: correct totals/margin/threshold or delete the sensitivity sentence. Confidence HIGH.

**N6 [LOW][statement-contradiction]** W omits U+2028/U+2029 (Zl/Zp).
Anchor: spec:20, spec:54. `alpha\u2028beta` survives normalization; decoded description contains a line separator, falsifying "never … a line break"/"always one-line"; AC1's `\n` oracle cannot fail. Fix: add U+2028/U+2029 to W (escape cost already in D) or narrow the claim to Cc/ASCII breaks. Confidence HIGH.

**N7 [LOW][stale-citation]** spec:109 says "five new service tests" but AC1–AC5 define six (AC3 counts two) plus T4 ByteBudget; `searchPayload` cited :1005-1032, actual :1008. Fix: correct count/anchors.

### Closure of supplied findings
F1 CLOSED — mechanism + AC1/AC2(a) oracles; ingestion claim removed (no `max_description_bytes` consumer confirmed). F2 CLOSED in substance — D≤36/hit term and 36 budget verified; totals wrong (N5). F3 NOT CLOSED (N3). F4 deferral structurally right (#165 OPEN, matching scope, no clamp/degenerate tests) but its rationale is false (N2). F5 CLOSED — AC2(c)–(g) present and falsifiable. F6 CLOSED — R5/T4/AC9/§8 carry no rollback-tolerance deliverable.

### Open Questions
[HIGH] §9.2's "operator lowers max at reload" counterexample: no production path reassigns `surface.cfg.Search` after `NewToolSurface` (only service_edge_test.go:707); bounds are process-frozen, so state that instead. Confidence MEDIUM.

### Positive Observations
Normalization-before-measurement is wire-only and deterministic; `match_count = len(fused)` is verified post-filter/pre-slice (search.go:421-435); AC3↔AC6 reconciliation is explicit; T1–T4 write paths are concrete; F6 removal is clean.

### Recommendation
REQUEST CHANGES
